stage1.impression: A clear cast puck with a blue top sits on a pale grey disc over dark gloss. The voids read as flat blue-and-white ellipses against a black interior, two blown vertical stripes make it look like moulded plastic, the pale disc makes it a candle on a saucer, and a hot sweep on the left edge pulls the eye out of frame.

blocking_9: The lower body (y 640-820) shows a lit field behind the voids rather than black: crush_pct under 5 in [680,680,840,800] and [940,640,1120,820], with lum_median 60-130
The voids' rims read silver against that field rather than as blue-white cut-outs on black
The centre label reads as dark satin near #2B2B2D (lum_median 40-80 on its exposed ring), not a pale grey coaster at 146-171
No clipped stripe on the body: clip_pct under 10 in [1130,640,1170,800] and [590,640,625,820]
No hot reflection on the frame's left edge: [0,450,120,1100] lum_median under 70, so the weight is the brightest thing in frame
The label's rendered colour matches its spec (out of scope here, see below)

changes.problem: The acrylic body transmits and reflects only the black cove, so the bottom two-thirds of the weight is black with the voids as isolated bright ellipses; air sealed in a solid needs a lit field behind it to show silver rims.

change.setting: new light: backlight card behind the weight

to.note: hidden from the camera directly by the weight; a soft vertical gradient (brighter at the bottom) if the set supports it

changes.expected: The body's interior becomes a mid-grey field seen through the acrylic, lum_median 60-130; void rims show as silver arcs against it by total internal reflection; crush in the body falls below 5 percent.

changes.problem: rimR refracts through the right of the body as a fully clipped vertical stripe, the hard-edged highlight of moulded plastic.
changes.expected: The right stripe holds detail, median 200-240, clip under 10 percent, still the brightest edge of the body.

changes.problem: rimL's 520 mm strip mirrors in the glossy vinyl at the frame's left edge as a hot vertical sweep (mirror point at about x -136 mm, y 0), the brightest large area in frame after the weight, pulling the eye off the product.

evidence.measured: lum_median 159, p95 224; profile across x 0-400 at y 700-760 falls 194, 125, 78, 58, 48, 43

changes.expected: The mirror point moves to about x -233 mm, outside the frame; the left edge drops to the vinyl's base value, lum_median 35-70; the weight keeps a left rim from the same side.

changes.problem: The left refracted stripe on the body is a quarter clipped and reads as a hard white bar rather than an edge highlight.
changes.expected: The left stripe sits at median 150-210 with clip under 10 percent, a little dimmer than the right edge, so the form turns.

changes.problem: The exposed ring of the dark satin centre label reads as pale grey aluminium, which turns the weight into a candle on a saucer; the overhead lands directly on it.

evidence.measured: rgb (149,146,144), lum_median 146, delta_e2000 37.6 against #2B2B2D; [520,640,600,780] lum_median 171, clip 6.6

changes.expected: The label ring falls toward a dark satin, lum_median 70-110 (the remainder is out of scope, below); the blue lamina keeps a median of 60 or more.

changes.problem: With less overhead the blue lamina must still read as a lit stratum; the front card is the only light on the top face from the camera side and is weak.
changes.expected: The top lamina stays at a median of 70-110 after c5, and the front face's lower void rims gain a little catch-light.

out_of_scope.request: Bring the centre label's rendered colour to #2B2B2D satin
out_of_scope.why: It renders as about #959290 (delta E 37.6) under direct light, far more than lighting accounts for; if its material or emission is not the specified dark satin it is a model error, and the pale disc is the main thing that makes the object read as a candle holder on a coaster rather than a weight on a record.

out_of_scope.request: Make the voids clearer or softer
out_of_scope.why: Fixed: they are real air. The fix is the backlit field (c1) that shows their silver rims.
